---
title: "Larkhaven Bikes: one week in June"
format: dashboard
---

```{r}
#| include: false
library(tidyverse)
library(reactable)
week <- read_csv("data/trips-week.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
stations <- read_csv("data/stations.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  distinct(station_id, .keep_all = TRUE)
```

## Row

```{r}
#| title: Trips by hour
week |>
  count(hour = hour(started_at)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = hour, y = n)) +
  geom_col() +
  labs(x = "Hour of the day", y = "Trips")
```

```{r}
#| title: Busiest start stations
week |>
  count(start_station, sort = TRUE) |>
  left_join(stations, join_by(start_station == station_id)) |>
  select(Station = name, Neighbourhood = neighbourhood, Trips = n) |>
  reactable(searchable = TRUE, defaultPageSize = 8)
```
